limitations: Unresolved Hubble detection and multibody collage do not establish local terrain, axes, calibrated visible colour, chemistry or a registered map. Neptune inset and other moons must not be assigned as Hippocamp geography.

NASA resource caption says no more than12miles across and historical23hour orbit; ESA2019 caption says approximately34km diameter. Preserve diameter discrepancy pending primary parameter audit; orbital period does not verify spin locking.
Monochrome acquisition is specified only as2009; inset2009-08-19 is separate. Exact UTC, filters, exposure/coaddition, raw products and publisher crosswalk remain open.
NASA download migration2023-09-09 and page update2024-11-02 are not observation dates. ESA rendition release2019-02-20T19:00 has unspecified timezone.
ESA rendition terms are independently CC BY4.0 subject to exceptions; no byte/pixel identity or blanket licence transfer to NASA image, papers, code or raw products asserted.
Proteus-fragment, impact, Triton-capture and reaccretion narratives are origin hypotheses, not directly observed history or local composition.
Black background and missing haze/rings are not evidence of atmospheric or ring absence. No angular/raster size calculation, generated view, map, shape or catalogue update.
Primary2019 paper, current orbital/rotation/shape solutions, recent sources and resolved geography/photometry remain open.
inspection: Displayed700x466 unchanged NASA unannotated frame: broad vertical Neptune mask, glare/residual structure and faint point detections; no labels or colour inset in this rendition. The publisher caption describes a composite family including separate inset/diagram, not all features present in this file. Individual unlabelled points are not independently cross-matched here; do not identify a particular point as Hippocamp without annotated/raw-product audit.
